'''Terrapins''' were a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Reptile/Legends|reptiles]]. The [[Kadrillian/Legends|Kadrillians]] were a species of semi-intelligent terrapins who had settled on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kadril]].<ref name="Marvel">{{GamerCite|1|The University of Sanbra Guide to Intelligent Life: The Marvel Series}}</ref>
